en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a snowy forest scene with tall conifer trees and a lone skier/walker in the distance. The back is printed in Romanian and Russian and reads that it depicts the Bucegi Mountains – Diham, a winter landscape. It bears the phrases REPUBLICA POPULARA ROMINA, CARTE POŞTALA, the publisher LIBRARIA NOASTRĂ, number 13, and a handwritten date Mai 1955.
